Hardwood Draft

Five picks. One season. One shot at a title.

How it plays. Set your lineup, then make five picks, guards first, then forwards (centers count as forwards). For each pick you choose between two conference-seasons, then draft one player from that board. Don't like what you see? You get two rerolls per draft. By default you see names and teams only; turn on Easy mode to see stats, or show each team's KenPom rank. Draft a player and every other season of his leaves the pool. Big numbers on a bad team are worth less than the same numbers on a contender. When the roster's full, your five play out a season and, if they're good enough, an NCAA tournament against real teams from 2010–2026, each rated by its final KenPom number and revealed one game at a time.
